summary: Completed docs-only next-MVP gate review for PMBOT. Verdict: usable local operator MVP with warnings; continue offline/local hardening and defer risk-boundary expansion.
non_blocking_gaps: Quality layer remains noisy: 149 warnings, including 123 action-required warnings, 25 review-needed warnings, and 1 informational warning.
Warning categories still need clearer owner/action paths so operators can distinguish accepted hygiene noise from repair work.
PAPER-019/PAPER-020 fixture coverage is intentionally small: 5 records, with only one open manual-review record and one blocked fixture record.
Accounting boundary fixture coverage should expand for zero cost, zero settlement, unusually large values, malformed values, and additional blocked/open variants.
A real local operator dry run should confirm the quickstart/static-report/review-pack workflow without task context.
Legacy schema_version, task_id, embedded pointer, and expected fixture alignment warnings remain cleanup candidates.
Command bridge examples are safe but command-shaped, so their inert status must remain explicit near every bridge surface.

recommended_next_tasks.summary: Run a docs/product dry run of the current local operator workflow and produce an acceptance checklist, operator confusion log, and final MVP use instructions.
Add or document owner/action paths for the largest quality warning categories without suppressing safety-relevant warnings.
Expand deterministic paper run series fixtures for settled, open manual-review, blocked, malformed, and accounting boundary records.
